fields.label: Timesteps
fields.help: steps this run adds (a continued run's step count carries on)

fields.label: Until stopped
fields.help: ignore the step budget and train until Stop

fields.label: Eval every (per env)
fields.help: x n_envs timesteps between evaluations

fields.label: Drone profile
fields.help: how the pretend drone behaves; 'measured' is fitted to the real flight logs

fields.label: Domain randomisation
fields.help: 0 = off, 1 = every episode draws a drone between ideal and harsh

fields.label: Hard starts
fields.help: share of starts behind / beside / below the ring

fields.label: Randomisation ramp (steps)
fields.help: 0 = full strength from the start

fields.label: Passes per episode
fields.help: 1 = single pass, 0 = endless laps

fields.label: Same side every time
fields.help: laps round the outside (else back-and-forth through the ring)

fields.label: Start from all 9 zones
fields.help: else the front runway

fields.label: Streak bonus
fields.help: pass k pays r_passed x min(1 + streak x (k-1), streak cap)

fields.label: Ring tracker (41 inputs)
fields.help: dead-reckoned ring position while the ring is out of view; a 37-input parent is widened with zero weights

fields.label: GAE lambda
fields.help: 1.0 = unbiased advantages (a baseline adds no bias)

fields.label: Target KL (trust region)
fields.help: stops an update's epochs early when the policy moved this far; empty = off

fields.label: Critic warm-up (steps)
fields.help: the actor is frozen while the critic learns the parent's values

fields.label: Reset log-std to
fields.help: a continued run can restart its action noise; empty = keep the parent's

fields.label: Evaluation copies
fields.help: evaluations run on this many copies at once (same layouts, faster; ~0.3-0.5 GB each); empty = parallel envs, at most 4

fields.label: Checkpoint every (min)
fields.help: latest_model.zip + checkpoints/ on a timer, so a crash loses minutes; 0 = off, empty = 15

fields.label: Focus on failing zones
fields.help: training starts favour the zones that fail (2 = worst zone up to 3x as often); 0 = even

fields.label: Cut stalled episodes (s)
fields.help: end a training episode after this long without a pass (try 30); 0 = off

fields.label: Normalise rewards
fields.help: steadier critic; nothing changes for replays or the drone

reward.help: weight of the progress shaping (metres gained towards the next waypoint)
extra pull onto the ring's axis near the plane (x radial metres)
time penalty per tick, and the 'drain' paid when an episode ends early
bonus for a counted pass (x the streak multiplier)
penalty for touching the noodle (the drain is added)
penalty for crossing the plane outside the opening (the drain is added)
penalty for leaving the cage (the drain is added)
once per search: first time the ring comes into view
penalty slope as the drone nears the noodle (full at touching)
clearance (m) at which the rim penalty starts
penalty for passing the wrong way / before re-arming
how far clear on the exit side before the next pass counts (m)
failures also cost w_time x the ticks left, so ending early is never cheaper
weight of the facing potential (camera towards the next waypoint)
the facing target sits this far behind the ring (m)
a pass only counts with forward . pass direction at least this
same-side laps: the way round passes this far beside the ring (m)
per tick loitering in the opening without pushing forward (train_onboard sets 0.05)
